# Haris Shakeel

> Haris Shakeel (Muhammad Haris) is an AI/ML engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan, specializing in applied computer vision, physics-based simulation, and agentic AI systems. He builds production computer-vision pipelines, multi-tenant agent platforms on the Claude Agent SDK and MCP, and full-stack products in Python/FastAPI and the MERN stack.

- Website: https://www.harisshakeel.site
- Email: harisshakeel061@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/harisshakeel
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/haris-shakeel-5559852b9
- Education: B.Sc. Computer Science, FAST NUCES Lahore (Dean's Honor List, 6 semesters)

## Experience

- **AI/ML Engineer, Xision** (Remote, 2026 – present): production computer-vision pipeline for an AI virtual try-on product, turning a single phone scan into a measurement-accurate 3D body model (MediaPipe, MiDaS depth, ONNX Runtime, SMPL-X) and a physically simulated garment fit.
- **Agentic AI Developer, Naxtech** (Remote, 2025 – 2026): engineered MAVIS, a multi-tenant platform putting Claude Code agents on real client work, with per-user OAuth across 3,000+ apps and Postgres row-level security as the tenant boundary.
- **Technical Lead, Payback** (Lahore, 2024 – 2025): led payback.pk, a live cashback platform with QR transactions, POS integration, and TOTP authentication, deployed on AWS.
- **Full-Stack Developer, Advance Resources** (Lahore, 2023 – 2024): CRM with WhatsApp automation on an action–trigger workflow engine; cut message delivery latency from 20s to 3s.

## Selected work

- [Xision](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/xision): AI virtual try-on, from phone scan to 3D body model to simulated garment fit.
- [MAVIS](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/mavis): multi-tenant Claude Code agent platform with MCP tool access and RLS isolation.
- [Metamorphix](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/metamorphix): Claude-powered prospect research and CRM outreach pipeline.
- [Sentinel](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/sentinel): real-time CCTV incident detection with YOLOv8 and mobile alerts.
- [Clusterden](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/clusterden): multi-tenant MERN CRM with real-time collaboration and WhatsApp automation.
- [Payback](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/payback): cashback platform with QR and POS transactions.
- More: [Meddo](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/meddo), [Comuni](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/comuni), [Green n Solar](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/green-n-solar), [Dynasty FM](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/dynasty), [613 Guys](https://www.harisshakeel.site/projects/613-guys)

## Skills

- Machine learning & computer vision: PyTorch, TensorFlow, YOLOv8, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, MediaPipe, SMPL-X, pose and monocular depth estimation, cloth-physics simulation
- LLMs & agentic AI: Claude Agent SDK, MCP, multi-agent orchestration, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, structured output
- Backend & data: FastAPI, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (RLS), Prisma, BullMQ, Redis, MongoDB, Supabase
- Frontend & mobile: React, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind CSS
- Cloud & DevOps: Google Cloud, AWS, Docker, Railway, Vercel, Sentry
